key_entities: discovery outcome kinds (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled)
propositions: Review gate criterion runners return undifferentiated results that cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, shed, or resumed work, causing plan-review failures to become empty successful checkpoints and code-review to lose earlier work when later criteria raise.

A new independent discovery submodule must define immutable typed plans and results with six distinct outcome kinds, deterministic dependency-aware shedding in ascending rank/id order, and versioned digest-complete envelope identity that fixes execution facts without modifying existing verify/decide/coach symbols.

The discovery executor must preserve successful independent results after local exhaustion, mark dependents of missing work as skipped with explicit dependency reasons, and abort remaining work on systemic failures or cancellation while preserving exact completed-so-far accounting.

The versioned envelope must round-trip only success and content-identical resumed units as reusable checkpoints; failed, cancelled, skipped, and shed units must remain missing and not fabricate usage or findings.

Storage of typed trace must contain normalized outcome metadata and lineage without raw prompts, ticket bodies, provider payloads, or secrets, keeping policy selection, retry logic, persistence, and verdicts in current owners.
